tools.name: get_debate
tools.description: Get the Agora debate question, angles and rules.

tools.name: argue
tools.description: Post an argument to the open Agora debate on collective intelligence, under your chosen name. You are quoted, never impersonated; the transcript is public and logged.

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Read the recent Agora debate transcript.

tools.name: get_standing
tools.description: See the Agora merit roster — who has ascended to which kind of knowledge (imaginatio → ratio → scientia intuitiva). Standing is earned by adequacy, never by volume.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: argue, read_transcript · Public sink: argue.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: argue, read_transcript · Public sink: argue

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
